scope.method_name: Provenance-Aware Intervention-Risk Routing for VLA Caches
scope.claim: On the pinned OpenVLA-OFT/LIBERO stack, PAIR-VLA improves the reliability-efficiency frontier over dense inference and the strongest faithfully runnable same-stack cache comparator.
claim_exclusions: state-of-the-art superiority over unreleased or non-runnable methods

expert_objective.label: mean absolute error over valid normalized continuous actions in the 8x7 chunk
expert_objective.terminal_padding: excluded using the dataset validity mask
expert_objective.signed_contract_regret: L1(expert, recursively cached action chunk) - L1(expert, dense action chunk)
expert_objective.gripper_training_coordinate: checkpoint-normalized continuous gripper coordinate before execution postprocessing
expert_objective.gripper_execution_diagnostic: unnormalize, map [0,1] to [-1,1], sign-binarize, then invert to the LIBERO convention

data.primary_exclusion: modified_libero_rlds/no_noops cannot establish original eight-step chronology and is diagnostic-only
data.p1_fail_closed: reject any trajectory lacking both cameras, original sequential identity, exact eight-future-action alignment, or matching normalization

atomic_groups.beta: 1 divided by the contract horizon for every query in the horizon
atomic_groups.mask_rule: suffix-safe, tile-aligned, nested by onset layer and resolved against exact SourceLedger provenance
atomic_groups.forbidden_primary_mask: any profile requiring token-wise fallback or an inferred previous-query source

allowed: exact source query and source age
camera, tile, onset layer, profile, and horizon identity
current-versus-actual-source raw patch L1, cosine, mean, maximum, and q90 change
current-versus-actual-source projected-tile L1, L2, cosine, norm, maximum, and q90 change
current and source normalized proprioception plus L1 and Linf changes
model-produced previous action summaries and source/current changes
contract horizon, remaining steps, source-mixture count, and abort history
previous-query attention or salience retained without a current dense pass
router_features.projected_feature_justification: OpenVLA-OFT computes current projected visual tokens before the downstream K/V reuse decision in the pinned BRACE path; summarization and transfer time are charged to routed overhead.
forbidden: expert or future actions as router inputs

router.selection: lowest calibration composite loss; within 1 percent choose the lower seed

splits.hash: SHA-256(dataset revision, suite, task, original trajectory id, split seed)

intervention_sampling.immutable_mask_id: SHA-256(anchor id, horizon, ordered source-resolved groups, sampling seed)

risk_selection.selection_rule: maximize P3-measured complete-cycle saving subject to frozen coverage, service, memory, and net-speed gates
risk_selection.gripper_transition_veto: fallback when predicted q90 gripper-coordinate distortion exceeds the selected delta or the transition lies outside calibration support

statistics.paired_success_primary: suite-stratified paired-condition bootstrap with equal suite weighting
statistics.latency_gate: point net saving at least 10 percent and one-sided 95 percent lower bound above zero

comparator_matching.matched_rule: For every PAIR operating point, select the comparator point with measured complete-cycle saving within 2 percentage points; if none exists, linearly interpolate only between two predeclared comparator budgets that bracket the PAIR point, otherwise report unmatched.
comparator_matching.claim_narrowing: No direct state-of-the-art claim against an unavailable or unfaithfully reproduced method.

p8_power_rule.input: P7 paired discordance rates and their upper 95 percent confidence bounds only
p8_power_rule.method: pre-outcome paired multinomial simulation at zero effect and the frozen noninferiority margin
p8_power_rule.stop: If 80 percent power requires more than 3000 episodes per method, stop for advisor review before P8.

outcome_protection.unblind_rule: episode success may be analyzed only after the expected terminal record count and a completed run summary both exist

stop_rules: Any provenance, chronology, normalization, mask, or identity mismatch stops the phase.
Any scientific threshold or population change after its protected population opens requires a versioned amendment and new approval.
Any memory reading at or above 23552 MiB, OOM, nonfinite value, or invalid timing stops the GPU phase.
Any use of success before the protected terminal condition invalidates the run.
No next phase begins without explicit user approval.
